analysis.summary: Management of Fonebox Retail Limited discussed their financial performance for H1 FY 2024-25, highlighting an 11% growth in PAT and a 17% increase in revenue compared to H1 FY 2024-25. They detailed their expansion plans primarily in Maharashtra, implementation of Power BI for inventory optimization, and strategic focus on increasing same-store sales and brand margins. Management provided revenue and profit guidance for FY25 and FY26, noting that growth is supported by a mix of Company Owned Company Operated (COCO) and Franchisee Owned Company Operated (FOCO) store models. Fonebox Retail Limited reported its investor presentation for the half year ended September 30, 2024, highlighting operational metrics such as 185 total active stores and steady financial growth including a revenue from operations of Rs. 16,465.28 lakhs for H1-25.

guidance.claim: The revenue target for FY 25 is around 400 plus crores without tax, and approximately 464 to 470 crores with tax.
guidance.quote: Revenue target for this year FY. 25. Our revenue target is 400 plus at least. If we calculate with tax it will nearly around so it is without tax. We are seeing on the balance sheet part on the Tax. With the tax it will lead around 464-470 crore.

guidance.claim: The smartphone retail market in India is projected to grow at a compound annual growth rate of 8-10% from 2024 to 2029.
guidance.quote: The smartphone retail market in India was valued at approximately $45 billion in 2~24 and is projected to grow at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 8-1~% from 2~24 to 2~29.

demand_outlook.claim: The growth of the smartphone retail market is fueled by increasing smartphone adoption, rollout of 5G technology, affordable device pricing, and a rising base of young, tech-savvy consumers.
demand_outlook.quote:
This growth is fueled by:

consumers

demand_outlook.claim: The company's management is optimistic regarding its future prospects.
demand_outlook.quote: The Management remains optimistic about the Company’s future prospects.

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into an agreement to acquire 100% equity shareholding in NWOM Retailers Private Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: the Company entered into a definitive Share Subscription and Purchase Agreement (“SSPA”) dated May 22, 2026, for the acquisition of 100% equity shareholding in NWOM Retailers Private Limited.

capex_expansion.claim: The acquisition consideration of ₹25.74 crore is proposed to be paid through a preferential allotment of equity shares.
capex_expansion.quote: The total consideration for the acquisition is ₹25.74 crore, proposed to be discharged through the allotment of equity shares of the Company on a preferential basis to the existing equity shareholder(s) of NWOM Retailers Private Limited.

margins_costs.claim: The company successfully negotiated with brands like Samsung, Vivo, and Xiaomi to increase margins this year.
margins_costs.quote: So I'm seeing on the some of the brands like Samsung, Vivo and Xiaomi. We are successful this year to increment our margin, and for rest of the brands, we are working closely to increase our margin.

margins_costs.claim: The company is focusing on strengthening its operational performance through effective cost management and domestic marketing.
margins_costs.quote: To further enhance shareholder value and sustain the growth momentum, the Company has focused on strengthening its operational performance through effective cost management and enhanced domestic marketing initiatives.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board did not recommend any dividend on equity shares for FY 2025-26 to conserve resources for future growth.
capital_allocation.quote: With a view to conserve the resources for future prospect and growth of the Company, the Board of Directors of the Company have not recommended any dividend on equity shares for the financial year ended 31st March, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company spent ₹8.95 Lakh on CSR activities during FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: During FY 2025-26, the Company spent ₹8.95 Lakh on CSR activities against the CSR obligation of ₹8.84 Lakh.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Secretarial Audit Report noted a 14-day delay in the submission of the Annual Report to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Secretarial Audit Report contains observations relating to delay of in 14 days in submission of the Annual Report to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited under Regulation 34 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company paid a regulatory penalty of ₹30,000 plus taxes for the delayed submission of the Annual Report.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Company subsequently completed the submission on 14th November, 2025 and paid the regulatory penalty of ₹30,000 (plus applicable taxes) levied by the Stock Exchange.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that for 2025, the core focus will exclusively be on sales, per square feet per store revenue, and per person revenue.
management_commitments.quote: and 25, our core focus will be only sales because we have set up all the things on the back-end side. Automated purchase orders are there, automated Inventory management are there, automated targets management are there. So now this year 2025, we have only one thing to focus, which is a per square feet per store revenue, and we are also introducing a per person revenue this year.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that in 2025, the primary focus for store expansion will be on Maharashtra only.
management_commitments.quote: So 2025, you are more focus will be on Maharashtra only.

management_commitments.claim: The Board has instituted stricter internal monitoring mechanisms to ensure timely compliance in all future filings.
management_commitments.quote: the Board confirms that necessary corrective measures and stricter internal monitoring mechanisms have been instituted to ensure strict, timely compliance in all future filings.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
